Built for bare-metal homelabs.Get StartedView on GitHubAbout the ProjectWhat is Botrus?Botrus is a Kubernetes cluster management platform designed for bare-metal homelab environments. Its dashboard uses externally supplied Kubernetes access, native Secrets, and FluxCD resource views. Cluster provisioning runs separately in an independent operator environment.Native SecretsOperator ManagedBuilt for HomelabsKey FeaturesIndependent Cluster ProvisioningProvision and recover your cluster from an independent operator environment. Provisioning is disabled in the packaged dashboard; the optional local runner requires separately supplied Ansible and playbooks.✓Keep bootstrap credentials available outside the target cluster✓Optional local runs report playbook progress✓Dashboard inventory records do not provision or join machinesGitOps with FluxCDInspect configured GitRepositories, Kustomizations, and HelmReleases. FluxCD reconciles resources owned by its configured sources when reconciliation is enabled. Credentials remain in native Kubernetes Secrets.✓View configured sources and Kustomization relationships✓Inspect readiness and suspended reconciliation status✓View hierarchy tree with live readiness status per resourceCluster Management DashboardView nodes, pods, deployments, services, ingresses, and storage using externally supplied Kubernetes access. Cached snapshots show freshness and availability; actions depend on current permissions and runtime settings.✓Hierarchical tree view of configured FluxCD resources✓Pod logs and optional pod shell for authorized operators✓Longhorn distributed storage visibility with PVC/PV trackingNative Kubernetes SecretsCredentials are managed through a TLS-verified Kubernetes API client; nonsecret configuration stays in SQLite. Protect Secret storage with cluster-level encryption and access controls configured by your operator.✓Explicit alias, namespace, Secret, and key mappings✓Bearer-authenticated lookup for a separately supplied Ansible plugin✓Explicit Ansible sync writes lookup references and inventory, not Secret valuesNativeKubernetes SecretsScopedAccess ControlsFluxCDResource StatusExternalCluster ProvisioningBuilt WithKubernetesFluxCDAnsibleLonghornNext.js 15xterm.jsPrismaTailwind CSSReady to get started?Connect to your cluster, inspect resources, and manage your homelab configuration.Get StartedView on GitHubBuilt for bare-metal homelabs.Botrus K8sKubernetes cluster management for bare-metal homelabs.
